input.content: Idempotency/recovery records looked up by resource (e.g. workspace) instead of by the caller-supplied operation ID. Because completed records are kept for audit, every later operation on that resource matches the old record: fresh IDs skip the write but still report success, and reusing an ID on another resource overwrites the audit record. Look up recovery state by the idempotency key only. (service.save, preferences save recovery review 2026-10-11)
